result.title: 밥솥으로 만든 초간단 점심 한끼 (Super Quick and Easy Rice Cooker Lunch)

evidences.text: Scooping rice into the rice cooker inner pot and washing it with water
새로 앉혀야 되는데
Adding water to the rice cooker inner pot to cook rice
우리집 냉동실에 소세지 많은데
Placing 2 thawed sausages into the rice cooker inner pot
버터는 필수
Melting butter in a heated frying pan
계란후라이 하나 만들어줘요
Cracking an egg into the pan with melted butter
그리고 쪽파... 음.. 대충 뭐.. 한 주먹 정도?
Cutting scallions with scissors directly into the rice cooker
간장이랑 참기름 그거 즉~당히 뿌려주면 돼요
Pouring soy sauce into the rice cooker pot
간장이랑 참기름 그거 즉~당히 뿌려주면 돼요
Drizzling sesame oil into the rice cooker pot
Sprinkling roasted sesame seeds into the rice cooker
김가루 뿌려주면 끝
Crushing seasoned seaweed and sprinkling flakes over the bowl
이거 김치 하나 딱 올려가지고 한 숟가락 크게 먹으면 진짜 맛있어요
Eating the rice dish topped with a piece of kimchi

steps.text: Wash rice in the rice cooker inner pot and fill with the required water.

evidences.text: Washing rice and draining water in the inner pot

steps.text: Lightly thaw frozen sausages in the microwave, place them on top of the rice and water in the cooker, and start the rice cooking cycle.

evidences.text: 전자레인지에 그냥 살~짝 해동시킨 다음에 밥 지을 때 같이 넣어버렸어요
Placing sausages into the pot and closing the rice cooker to cook

steps.text: Shortly before the rice finishes, melt butter in a frying pan and make a fried egg.

evidences.text: 거의 다 될 때쯤에 계란후라이 하나 만들어줘요 버터는 필수
Melting butter in a pan and frying an egg

steps.text: Once the rice is done cooking, open the cooker and slice the sausages into bite-sized pieces using scissors.

evidences.text: 자 이제 밥 다 됐으면 소세지 작게 잘라주고
Cutting the sausages into pieces with kitchen scissors directly in the pot

steps.text: Cut about a handful of scallions directly into the rice cooker using scissors.

evidences.text: 그리고 쪽파... 음.. 대충 뭐.. 한 주먹 정도? 그 위에 가위로 잘라줘요
Snipping scallions into small pieces over the rice with scissors

steps.text: Add soy sauce, sesame oil, and sesame seeds to taste, then mix everything together thoroughly.

evidences.text: 그다음 제일 만만한 한국인 소스 조합 있죠 간장이랑 참기름 그거 즉~당히 뿌려주면 돼요
Pouring seasonings and stirring the rice, sausages, and scallions together

steps.text: Transfer the mixed rice to a serving bowl, top with the fried egg and crushed seaweed flakes, and serve (optionally with kimchi).

evidences.text: 그릇에 옮겨 담아주고 자 이제 그 위에 계란후라이랑 김가루 뿌려주면 끝
Placing fried egg and crushed seaweed flakes over the rice in a bowl
